instruction: Play the most listened to song on Spotify from the Velvet Underground album.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. show_profile reveals the supervisor's email (spotify username); show_account_passwords reveals the spotify password; login yields the token. search_albums (no token needed) finds the 'Velvet Underground' album and its song_ids; show_song (no token needed) must be called on every song to learn play_count. Since quantified preconditions are not allowed, the album's songs are modeled as an ordered chain (next-song / checked-upto / last-song) starting from a sentinel object song-start, so the planner must call show_song on each song before play_music, whose extra parameters (album, last song) only enforce that the whole album has been inspected. The actual number of songs is unknown at modeling time; the problem uses three placeholder songs and the static fact (most-played ...) stands for the runtime max over play_count (the agent must iterate over all song_ids returned). play_music with song_id sets the music player to playing that song (only spotify.MusicPlayer changes); complete_task is called without an answer and is forced last.
